name: Discovery Adventures
description_short: Week-long themed history day programs at Old Sturbridge Village, a living history museum. In summer, kids ages 6 to 17 spend 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. in 19th-century costume, cooking over the open hearth, doing farm chores, making crafts and working with the Village's costumed historians. Groups are by age, with themes that change each week.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds are available up to two weeks before your week's program starts. You can switch weeks if there is space in your child's age group; a change fee applies.
